businesses.business: engineered components and industrial test systems

offering_description.value: ESCO Technologies designs and manufactures aircraft fluid-control and filtration components and naval systems for aerospace manufacturers, shipbuilders and defense customers. It supplies power equipment diagnostics and renewable energy measurement systems to utilities and energy developers. It builds and installs electromagnetic test systems for manufacturers and laboratories.

primary_products.value: aircraft filtration and fluid-control components; naval signature management and power systems; electrical equipment diagnostics and monitoring systems; wind and solar measurement systems; electromagnetic test chambers and instruments

primary_services.value: utility asset diagnostic testing and engineering consulting; technical training; electromagnetic test facility design and installation; instrument calibration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Aircraft manufacturers, defense contractors, shipbuilders, electric utilities, renewable energy developers, electronics manufacturers and independent test laboratories; B2G: Naval procurement agencies and government test laboratories

end_markets.value: commercial aerospace; naval and military defense; electric power transmission and distribution; renewable energy; electronics and automotive testing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Aircraft and naval components, electrical diagnostic instruments, renewable energy sensors and electromagnetic test equipment; project or contract: Custom defense systems and turnkey electromagnetic test facilities; service fees: Utility diagnostics, engineering consulting, technical training and instrument calibration
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.category: component supplier; OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform
